control_definitions.window: Start at least five singlets and five triplets; enlarge to ten of each for representatives and further if the selected state lies at the boundary. Compare a common energy window containing S1 and neighboring candidate triplets.
control_definitions.geometry: For Ph-mP and An-mP freeze the terminal-aromatic/phenylene linking torsion at 45 degrees, relax other S0 coordinates, and repeat the state/SOC window. Define the four mapped torsion atoms. Use the four explicit benchmark atom IDs in each terminal_bridge_control; their ordering defines the signed +45-degree target.
control_definitions.series: After representative calibration, compute the relaxed-geometry state/SOC window for Na-mP and Py-mP using the same protocol.
control_definitions.competition: For every candidate high-triplet channel report at least the two neighboring triplets and their character; near degeneracy or alternative localization may change the inference.

observable_definition: For a matched physical Tn, delta_STn=E(S1;R_S0)-E(Tn;R_S0). Report SOC norms in cm^-1 and neighboring Tn±1 spacings at the same geometry and Hamiltonian. Energy/SOC support necessary channel prerequisites; neither is an absolute RISC rate or quantum yield.

required_comparisons.description: Four-member matched state windows with high-state SOC
Competing high-state channels and bounded inference

optional_not_scored: Nonadiabatic dynamics, absolute RISC rates and quantum efficiencies are optional.
source_note: Molecular identities, benchmark-defined starts and explicitly labelled measured observations are authorized inputs. Graph provenance identifies chemical identity only; state labels, optimized added geometries and predicted outputs are withheld. See task.md for the common scientific scope.
public_private_boundary: Identity/connectivity and declared measured observations are public. Author optimized new candidate geometries, computed rankings, reference outputs and legacy PASS archives are private.
